label: Codex CLI `codex review`, default model and reasoning effort

isolation.sandbox: workspace-write, network_access false, pinned with -c sandbox_mode

adapter.range_transport: stdin prompt naming `git diff main...review-head` (codex review --base refuses a prompt)
adapter.packet_transport: stdin prompt after the range instruction (`codex review - < prompt.txt`)
adapter.output_capture: stdout.txt verbatim; overall_correctness read from the child rollout's final JSON
